description: Illustrative kye.boundary.v1 instance — two third-party boundaries crossed through different channels, both governed at t=0 by an existing PEP. Channel-agnostic: the git-api crossing and the http-inbound crossing share the same governance contract.

boundaries.label: GitHub API (push · merge)
boundaries.description: Every push/merge is decided at t=0 by the dev-plane PEP before the irreversible GitHub API call.

boundaries.label: internal service→surface admission
boundaries.description: An INTERNAL boundary — a crossing between KYE trust domains is admitted + evidenced at t=0 before effect. Internal ≠ ungoverned (§0.39 + §0.11). (Illustrative; the canonical registry binds internal crossings to the PDP border-admission.)

boundaries.label: admin request plane
boundaries.description: Every mutating inbound request routes through the §0.38 central middleware, kye-id'd and §0.3-evidenced before the handler runs.
